merge-every-arm.sql: MERGE INTO "app"."account" AS "t" USING "staged" AS "s" ON "t"."id" = "s"."id" WHEN MATCHED AND "s"."name" IS NULL THEN DELETE WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET "name" = "s"."name", "visits" = "t"."visits" + $1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id", "name") VALUES ("s"."id", "s"."name") WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE RETURNING merge_action(), "t"."id", old."name" AS "was"

merge-unconditional-last.sql: MERGE INTO "app"."account" AS "t" USING "staged" AS "s" ON "t"."id" = "s"."id" WHEN MATCHED AND "s"."kind" = $1 THEN UPDATE SET "name" = $2 WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE WHEN NOT MATCHED AND "s"."kind" = $3 THEN DO NOTHING WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES

merge-overriding-only.sql: MERGE INTO ONLY "app"."account" AS "t" USING "staged" AS "s" ON "t"."id" = "s"."id" WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id") OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES ($1) WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND "t"."active" = $2 THEN UPDATE SET "active" = $3

merge-with-source.sql: WITH "fresh" AS (SELECT "id" FROM "staged" WHERE "id" > $1) MERGE INTO "app"."account" AS "t" USING "fresh" ON "t"."id" = "fresh"."id" WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id") VALUES ("fresh"."id") RETURNING *

merge-subquery-source.sql: MERGE INTO "app"."account" AS "t" USING (SELECT "id", "name" FROM "staged") AS "s" ON "t"."id" = "s"."id" WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET "name" = "s"."name"

merge-as-cte.sql: WITH "changed" AS (MERGE INTO "app"."account" AS "t" USING "staged" AS "s" ON "t"."id" = "s"."id" WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET "name" = "s"."name" WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id", "name") VALUES ("s"."id", "s"."name") RETURNING merge_action(), "t"."id") SELECT "merge_action", "id" FROM "changed"
